retrospective.content: The first implementation is an in-memory row map with an append-only committed WAL. It exercises statement atomicity and recovery, but cannot satisfy the formal over-memory storage tests. P2 must replace it with bounded disk pages, a PK index, and checkpointing.

New disk-backed primary B+Tree and bounded caches remove O(N) committed-row residency. Query exact recall remains correct in sampled tests. COW requires page coalescing to avoid high I/O write amplification. Phase2 has a small 10k benchmark latency/I/O/RSS regression relative to Phase1; this is a measured design tradeoff, not a speed win. Official cgroup metrics and ANN indexing remain unfinished.

Disk IVF-Flat is now implemented and transactionally reconciled with the primary B+Tree. In 128D random data, probing 8/64 partitions does not meet recall; probing 64/64 is far slower than exact scan. A cost guard uses exact scan on the benchmark scale while preserving explicit ANN path for experiments. WAL generational recycling is crash-safe in local failpoint tests, but heap and COW index page reclamation still need implementation.

Official first public SQL cases exposed a result-metadata gap: successful DML had no affected_rows field. Added affected_rows to core Result and a local structured adapter without guessing the organizer stdin/stdout protocol. AVX2 is only a conservative screening stage; canonical scalar L2 still ranks borderline candidates, protecting exact correctness. Performance improvement applies to in-memory dense scan below the cache budget; data exceeding that budget still uses slower disk traversal. Physical cgroup v2 I/O/memory and hidden acceptance remain unverified.

limitations: Official second-round SQL driver, exact errors, readiness marker, ANN selector and frozen resource limits have not been verified.
Only genuine user prompt, tool observations and agent retrospective were included; no independent student interpretation or experimental reflections have been invented.
Large explicit WriteSet and unbounded SELECT result may allocate beyond fixed cache limits.
Only local process RSS and I/O, no isolated cgroup v2 memory.peak/io.stat; Docker image not built.
No team GitHub branch creation/push because connected integration returned 403.
Vector index and WAL generation recycling are implemented; heap and COW B+Tree old-page compaction are NOT implemented.
True IVF-Flat at 8/64 probes falls below Recall@10=0.95; default cost planner selects exact for 10K benchmark, not ANN acceleration.
The student did not provide their own quantitative interpretation of these tool results; tool observations and agent commentary alone do not establish student learning evidence.

Official public mysqltest directory provides basic SQL/expected JSON only. The private run_case.py, complete test driver protocol, hidden cases, frozen performance baseline, Docker validation and cgroup metrics are still unavailable here.

limitations.content: Phase6 local performance best among tested options, not proven globally optimal. Hidden admission suite, official runner, cgroup v2 IO/memory and Docker image unverified; remote GitHub branch write remains blocked.

NumPy truth checking runs on host after timing and does not contribute to DB container resources.
Results are not an official score: official baseline and hidden workloads are unavailable.
